loop.health_check: Send the cheapest query the provider documents for the chain (or a GET to its base URL). Alive = any HTTP response within 5s, including 401 (server up, key missing) and 429 (server up, rate-limited). Dead = no response within 5s, connection error, or 5xx.
loop.key_rotation: TronGrid and TronScan each take 1-50 keys (trongrid_keys[0..49], tronscan_keys[0..49]). On 429 or quota-exhausted, move to the next key and log the switch. A key that keeps failing is parked until its quota resets.
loop.note: No retry on the same provider for a hard failure (timeout, connection error, 5xx). A 429 means rate-limited: rotate to the next API key for that provider if keys remain, else move to the next provider. One full pass over a chain's list takes at most 5s per provider, so a 3-provider chain resolves in at most 15s.
loop.on_all_fail: Log the outage, keep the last good state, alert, and do not serve stale data as fresh.
loop.record: Which provider answered each request, so a dead provider is visible instead of silent.
loop.rule: Try providers in order. First one that answers wins. Never depend on one provider.

types.explorer-api: An explorer's API (same company as its scanner, different system from its RPC).
types.indexer-api: Indexed API for machines (balances, history, token transfers, metadata). The query layer.
types.rpc: Node RPC for machines (state, execution, current block). No universal wallet-history method.
types.scanner: Block explorer UI for humans (browse an address, transaction or token). Not a query API.
